Both the government and LIC will withdraw their nominees from the bank's board and become public shareholders. The Cabinet Committee on Economic Affairs has empowered the Alternative Mechanism for minority stake sales of the government's holdings. LIC will manage its residual shareholding as per internal procedures and regulatory compliance.

banking-economy.title: From SGX Nifty to GIFT Nifty: Understanding the evolution of India's global market indicator
banking-economy.summary: July 2023 heralded an important change for India as it moved from SGX Nifty to GIFT Nifty, a development with major implications for the financial sector. GIFT Nifty aligns with Indian regulations and provides attractive tax incentives for foreign investors. This initiative is intended to strengthen India's financial infrastructure and position it more firmly within the ranks of international financial hubs.
